slices.focus: Holds firm on no more cash for Logan, offering job leads and training support instead
slices.summary: Derek's mother calls asking for another loan for Logan, but Derek holds the line — no money, but he will offer job leads, union-adjacent training options, and one evening to review postings together. The conversation leaves a cooler distance with his mother, who frames his refusal as coldness, and Logan who must adjust to practical help rather than cash. Derek commits to one specific evening offer without repeated follow-up, a short script for his mother ('I'm willing to help with leads and training options, but I am not giving money'), and tolerating the cooler phase rather than rushing to smooth things over.
